arabic text: Beti hussain ki sar-e-darbaar ayi hai
english translation text: Hussain's daughter has been brought before the court

arabic text: Masoom khun bhare huwe ruksaar layi hai\nBeti hussain ki sar-e-darbaar ayi hai
english translation text: The innocent child has brought bloodstained cheeks\nHussain's daughter has been brought before the court

arabic text: Aya hai hay tasht mei rakha sar-e-hussain, sab has rahe hai aur\nsakina ke lab pe bayn, kya khub hai ye ajre-e-risalaat duhaaye hai\nBeti hussain ki sar-e-darbaar ayi hai
english translation text: Hussain's head has been brought upon a tray; everyone laughs while\nSakina laments: what a splendid reward you have given for the Prophet's mission!\nHussain's daughter has been brought before the court

arabic text: Nabiyo ke saf mei hai saf-e-matam biche huwi, nabze ye qayinaat\nki kyu hai ruki huwi, khun khaar rasiyo mei ye kiski kalaayi hai\nBeti hussain ki sar-e-darbaar ayi hai
english translation text: Among the prophets, a mourning row has been spread; why has the pulse\nof creation stopped? Whose wrists are these, wounded and bound in bloodied ropes?\nHussain's daughter has been brought before the court

arabic text: Hal chal hai qaydiyo mei ye kaisi phir ek bar, dar khul raha hai\nhaye sakina ki hai fugaa, hukm-e-rihaayi aya hai ya mawt ayi hai\nBeti hussain ki sar-e-darbaar ayi hai
english translation text: Why is there sudden commotion among the captives? The prison door is opening,\nand Sakina cries: is this the order of freedom, or has death arrived?\nHussain's daughter has been brought before the court

arabic text: Gurbat me khaak uraayi thi jaise hussain ne, akbar ki lash uthaayi\nthi jaise hussain ne, Abid ne aise lashe sakina uthayi hai\nBeti hussain ki sar-e-darbaar ayi hai
english translation text: Just as Hussain scattered dust upon himself in grief, and lifted\nAkbar's body, so did Abid lift Sakina's body\nHussain's daughter has been brought before the court

arabic text: Mara hai taziyaana uthaya hai kisko hay, zalim ne ye kaneezi mei\nmaanga hai kisko hay, kyu gash mei haye zainab dilgeer ayi hai\nBeti hussain ki sar-e-darbaar ayi hai
english translation text: Who has been struck with the whip? Who has the tyrant demanded\nas a slave? Why has grieving Zainab fallen unconscious?\nHussain's daughter has been brought before the court
